title: Eos opens the gates of morning
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Tiepolo's ceiling frescoes
alt: Eos, goddess of dawn, pushes open golden gates above the clouds while four white horses wait and the sun rises on the left.

title: The forge at first light
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Caravaggio
alt: A smith rests on his hammer beside a finished bronze shield in a dark forge; the sun rises through the open door.

title: Hermes at the city gate
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Poussin
alt: Hermes hands a sealed scroll to a gatekeeper at a city wall as the sun comes up behind distant hills.

title: The Argo, finished
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Turner
alt: A finished wooden ship stands on a beach at sunrise; the shipwrights sleep beside their tools.

title: Daedalus's workshop
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of the Dutch Golden Age
alt: A pair of finished feather wings lies on a workbench by a window; the sun rises over the sea outside.

title: Athena's owl comes home
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Roman wall painting
alt: A white owl with an olive branch flies over Athens at sunrise, painted like a cracked red Roman fresco.

title: Sheaves at sunrise
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Van Gogh
alt: Bound wheat sheaves in a field under a swirling dawn sky with a large yellow sun.

title: The last furrow
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Millet
alt: A ploughman and two oxen finish the last furrow of a dark field as the sun breaks the horizon.

title: Seaport at sunrise
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Claude Lorrain
alt: A classical harbour at sunrise with tall ships at anchor and cargo stacked on the quay.

title: The kiln at dawn
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Roman floor mosaics
alt: A potter rests beside rows of finished amphorae at an open kiln while the sun rises over low hills, made of small mosaic stones.

title: Above the morning fog
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Caspar David Friedrich
alt: A traveller seen from behind stands on a rock above a valley filled with morning fog at sunrise.

title: The boats return
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of Hiroshige
alt: Fishing boats return to harbour under a red rising sun, in the style of a Japanese woodblock print.

title: The Muses at sunrise
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of early Renaissance frescoes
alt: The Muses rest on a hillside at sunrise, their lyres laid in the grass and a finished scroll tied with a ribbon.

title: The finished book
credit: Generated for Morndo, in the manner of medieval books of hours
alt: A scribe has closed a gold-decorated book in a monastery writing room; the candle is burnt down and the sun rises through an arched window.
